an8.70:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an8.70:1.2: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
an8.70:1.3: vesāliyā piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi;
an8.70:1.6: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā nisīdanamādāya bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.
an8.70:2.1: atha kho bhagavā yena cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an8.70:2.2: nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
an8.70:3.1: ramaṇīyā ānanda vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ udenaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sattambaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ.
an8.70:3.2: yassa kassaci ānanda cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, ākaṅkhamāno so, ānanda kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya, kappāvasesaṃ vā.
an8.70:3.3: tathāgatassa kho ānanda cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, ākaṅkhamāno ānanda tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya, kappāvasesaṃ vāti.
an8.70:3.4: evampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ.
an8.70:3.6: tiṭṭhatu bhante, bhagavā kappaṃ tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti, yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
an8.70:4.2: tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
an8.70:4.3: ramaṇīyā ānanda, vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ udenaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sattambakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ.
an8.70:4.4: yassa kassaci ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, ākaṅkhamāno so ānanda, kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya, kappāvasesaṃ vā.
an8.70:4.5: tathāgatassa kho ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, ākaṅkhamāno ānanda tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya, kappāvasesaṃ vāti.
an8.70:4.6: evampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ.
an8.70:4.8: tiṭṭhatu bhante, bhagavā kappaṃ tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti, yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhita citto.
an8.70:5.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
an8.70:5.2: gaccha tvaṃ ānanda, yassadāni kālaṃ maññasīti.
an8.70:5.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā bhagavato avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
an8.70:5.4: atha kho māro pāpimā acirapakkante āyasmante ānande bhagavantaṃ etadavoca;
an8.70:6.1: parinibbātu bhante, bhagavā. parinibbātu sugato. parinibbānakālodāni bhante, bhagavato.
an8.70:6.2: bhāsitā kho panesā bhante bhagavatā vācā:
an8.70:6.3: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi yāva me bhikkhu na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desissanti paññāpessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānī karissanti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desissantīti.
an8.70:6.4: etarahi bhante bhikkhu bhagavato sāvakā viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññapenti paṭṭhapenti, vivaranti vibhajanti uttānī karonti. uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
an8.70:7.1: parinibbātu’dāni bhante bhagavā parinibbātu sugato, parinibbānakālo’dāni bhante, bhagavato.
an8.70:7.3: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā …pe…
an8.70:7.5: yāva me upāsikā na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti, desissanti, paññapessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappaṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desissantīti.
an8.70:7.6: etarahi bhante upāsikā bhagavato sāvikā viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññapenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti. uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
an8.70:8.1: parinibbātu ‘dāni bhante bhagavā parinibbātu sugato, parinibbāna kālo’ dāni bhante bhagavato.
an8.70:8.2: bhāsitā kho panesā bhante bhagavatā vācā:
an8.70:8.3: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi. yāva me idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na iddhaṃ ceva bhavissati phītañca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitanti.
an8.70:8.4: etarahi bhante bhagavato brahmacariyaṃ iddhañceva phītañca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitaṃ.
an8.70:9.1: parinibbātu ‘dāni bhante bhagavā, parinibbātu sugato, parinibbāna kālo’ dāni bhante bhagavatoti.
an8.70:9.2: appossukko tvaṃ pāpima hohi, naciraṃ tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati,
an8.70:9.3: ito tiṇṇaṃ māsānaṃ accayena tathāgato parinibbāyissatīti.
an8.70:10.1: atha kho bhagavā cāpāle cetiye sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossaji.
an8.70:10.2: ossaṭṭhe ca bhagavatā āyusaṅkhāre mahābhūmicālo ahosi bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso. devadundubhiyo ca caliṃsu.
an8.70:10.3: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi.
an8.70:12.3: sumahāvatāyaṃ bhūmicālo bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.
an8.70:12.4: ko nukho hetu. ko paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyāti:
an8.70:13.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.70:13.3: sumahāvatāyaṃ bhante bhūmicālo bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso. devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.
an8.70:13.4: ko nukho bhante hetu, ko paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyāti:
an8.70:14.1: aṭṭhi me ānanda hetu, aṭṭha paccayā mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya,
an8.70:14.3: ayaṃ ānanda mahāpaṭhavi udake patiṭṭhitā. udakaṃ vāte ṭhitaṃ, vāto ākāsaṭṭho hoti. so ānanda samayo yaṃ mahāvātā vāyanti, mahāvātā vāyantā udakaṃ kampenti. udakaṃ kampitaṃ paṭhaviṃ kampeti.
an8.70:14.4: ayaṃ ānanda paṭhamo hetu paṭhamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:15.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā iddhimā cetovasippatto devatā vā mahiddhikā mahānubhāvā tassa parittā paṭhavisaññā bhāvitā hoti, appamāṇā āposaññā. so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ kampeti. saṅkampeti, sampakampeti
an8.70:15.2: ayaṃ ānanda dutiyo hetu, dutiyo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:16.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda yadā bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā sato sampajāno mātukucchiṃ okkamati, tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṅkampati sampakampati.
an8.70:16.2: ayaṃ ānanda tatiyo hetu. tatiyo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:17.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda yadā bodhisatto sato sampajāno mātu kucchismā nikkhamati, tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṅkampati sampakampati.
an8.70:17.2: ayaṃ ānanda catuttho hetu catuttho paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:18.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda yadā tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammā sambodhiṃ abhisambujjhati. tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati, saṅkampati sampakampati.
an8.70:18.2: ayaṃ ānanda pañcamo hetu pañcamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:19.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda yadā tathāgato anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavatteti, tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati, saṅkampati sampakampati.
an8.70:19.2: ayaṃ ānanda chaṭṭho hetu, chaṭṭho paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:20.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda yadā tathāgato sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossajati, tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati, saṅkampati, sampakampati.
an8.70:20.2: ayaṃ ānanda sattamo hetu, sattamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:21.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda yadā tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyati, tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati, saṅkampati, sampakampati.
an8.70:21.2: ayaṃ ānanda aṭṭhamo hetu, aṭṭhamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:21.3: ime kho ānanda aṭṭhahetu, aṭṭhapaccayā mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyāti.
